tokens.v: A hand pulls the can straight up out of a steel cooler packed with crushed ice at a beach volleyball sideline, ice water sheeting off the matte body and beads flying where the wrist snaps, hard noon sun putting one clean specular down the pale-yellow flank. 85mm at f/2.8 at cooler height, the net and a diving player dissolved to bokeh far behind, a striped towel and a second dripping can blurred in the near foreground, cut by the bottom edge. FERRO & SONS sits small in the green stripe, condensation standing proud over the ink.
